title: Mace Window
description: A legal Fabric client HUD for mace PvP fall-charge timing, cooldown discipline, and landing-risk awareness.
body:
# Mace Window

Mace Window is a client-side Fabric HUD for mace PvP that helps you read fall-charge timing without automating combat. It focuses on the part of mace fights that is easy to misjudge: whether your drop has enough pressure to be worth committing, whether your weapon cooldown is ready, and whether the landing is starting to become risky.

## Features

- Fall-charge readiness panel for mace engagements
- Attack cooldown bar so manual swings are easier to time
- Landing-risk warning based on your current fall state
- Session best charge readout for quick practice feedback
- Compact HUD designed to stay out of the crosshair area
- Full Mod Menu config screen for position, scale, thresholds, and colors

## PvP Fairness

Mace Window does not aim, click, move, select items, predict server-side hits, or automate any combat action. It only displays client-side timing information that is already visible through normal gameplay.

## Compatibility

- Minecraft: 1.21.11
- Loader: Fabric
- Requires: Fabric API
- Optional: Mod Menu for in-game configuration
